gold_access: after verified prediction seal only; parse gold rows only for the frozen DEV5 IDs
fact_identity: case-local observation identity plus casefolded Unicode alphanumeric tokens for subject, attribute, value, and polarity
information_retention_recall: semantically exact admitted MemoryFact claims divided by gold old+new atomic states; raw evidence-only text is not counted as a semantic fact
fact_semantic_precision_recall: exact normalized structured fact tuple and supporting observation match; rejected claims are not usable predictions
evidence_grounding: a semantic fact is correctly grounded only if its persisted evidence belongs to the same observation/group and its stored span round-trips exactly to source text; gold support must name that same source observation
admission_accuracy: N/A because this benchmark gold has no independent per-fact admission labels; report verified-gold-fact recall and false-verified count instead
old_state_candidate_recall: gold root-revision old state appears in the production linker candidate pool, divided by root revision opportunities with a matching revision trace
correct_old_new_pair_rate: chosen linker target matches the gold old state for a traceable gold root revision, divided by traceable gold root revision opportunities
direct_revision_seed_dependency_propagat: micro-averaged exact normalized fact-pair/status identities; unmatched method-failure cases contribute no predicted events, transport/infrastructure failures invalidate the run and are not scored
over_under_invalidation: count old gold states whose runtime lifecycle destructively differs from the gold invalidated set, and missed gold invalidations respectively
premise_accuracy: exact response-policy match only where gold_behavior supplies a supported premise_status mapping; otherwise N/A
answer_metrics: official frozen normalized exact match and token F1, averaged over successful DEV5 cases; method failures score zero only for answer metrics, infrastructure failures prevent evaluation
cost: confirmed responses and token usage from durable request/response journals; no price estimate
